6 تعارضا They opposed each other. (Ibn-Maaroof, in Golius. [The verb is very often used in this sense.]) ―
-b2- They fought, or combated, each other. (MA.) ―
-b3- They did each like as the other did; they imitated each other: they vied, competed, or contended, each with the other; they emulated, or rivalled, each other: (TA in art. برى:) syn. تَبَارَيَا. (K in that art.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
